name: Question 6
problem: The temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit, of a rapidly cooling substance after $t$ minutes can be modeled by the function $F(t)=250-{t}^{3}.$ Find the instantaneous rate at which the temperature of the substance is changing with respect to time at the moment when the temperature of the substance is equal to $34$ degrees Fahrenheit.

Question 6

The temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit, of a rapidly cooling substance after t minutes can be modeled by the function F(t)=250−t3. Find the instantaneous rate at which the temperature of the substance is changing with respect to time at the moment when the temperature of the substance is equal to 34 degrees Fahrenheit.

a
−50 degrees Fahrenheit per minute
b
−36 degrees Fahrenheit per minute
c
−108 degrees Fahrenheit per minute
d
−72 degrees Fahrenheit per minute
e
−54 degrees Fahrenheit per minute
